decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 2 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 3 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 5 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
Condition : 6 - The street number of the property shall be displayed on the fascia hereby approved.

Condition : 7 - The retention of externally illuminated fascia and projecting signs to the existing unit, as shown on drawing number AL167-WD-103C received 21 November 2006, is satisfactory as the development would not adversely affect the visual quality of the building or the character of the street scene and appearance and character of Turnham Green Conservation Area, and would not prejudice the flow of traffic or pedestrian use of the adjacent public highway. Therefore the development complies with relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.1.4 Advertisements, and S.4.3 Advertisements and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 8 - 1.	The advertisement hereby approved shall be displayed before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
description: Retention of externally illuminated fascia and projecting signs to the existing unit
